name: proportionality
wording: a cut's ceremony scales with its size and the risk to meaning it carries: a small cut is one work package, one builder and one assayer, a larger or riskier one has two assayers, so the method never costs more than the change. A change that preserves behaviour, such as a refactor or a chore, is not a cut but ordinary engineering, checked and reviewed by pull request; work that changes nothing, such as a review of existing work, is not a cut either.
reason: 0218: a review of delivered work was forced through a cut.
